headline: Gondola 3A goes before Town Council Meeting on Thursday, August 20
blurb: A full agenda for Mountain Village this Thursday. The most consequential action item is a resolution setting a sale price appreciation cap under Municipal Code Section 16.02.070 — the kind of deed-restriction mechanics that determine whether affordable units actually stay affordable over time. Council also takes up a 2026 budget appropriation amendment and a conditional use permit for temporary office space on Lot 68R.

meeting.title: Town Council Meeting
meeting.location: Town Hall, 455 Mountain Village Blvd, Suite A
